# Customize the workflow generated by Deploy Now (Laravel)

Path: `.github/workflows/<project>-build.yaml` (workflow v2)

Deploy Now's wizard fills in most steps for Laravel. Verify and adjust:

## A. PHP version + extensions

```yaml
      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.2'
          extensions: intl, mbstring, mysqli, pdo_mysql, curl, gd, fileinfo, zip, bcmath, xml
          coverage: none
          tools: composer:v2
```

## B. Composer

```yaml
      - name: Install Composer dependencies
        run: composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader --no-interaction --prefer-dist
```

## C. Front-end assets (Vite)

```yaml
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Build assets
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm run build
```

## D. Generate APP_KEY at build time (alternative pattern)

Instead of using a GitHub secret, you can generate `APP_KEY` during the build:

```yaml
      - name: Generate application key
        run: |
          cp .env.example .env
          php artisan key:generate --force
```

Both patterns are valid. The secret-based approach is more reproducible across deploys.

## E. Storage symlink

`php artisan storage:link` runs as a **post-deployment remote command** (in `.deploy-now/<project>/config.yaml`), not as a build step, because it must run on the runtime filesystem.

## F. Do NOT modify

Bottom steps that reference `ionos-deploy-now/template-renderer-action` and `ionos-deploy-now/deploy-to-ionos-action`. They depend on internal outputs.

## G. Publish directory env

```yaml
env:
  DEPLOYMENT_FOLDER: ./
```

Apache serves `public/` because of the dashboard publish-directory setting, not the workflow.
